raw_segments.text: He married Bianca Maria Visconti, a natural daughter of Filippo Visconti, the Duke of
Milan, on whose death he procured his own elevation to the Duchy.
Machiavelli was the accredited agent of the Florentine Republic to Cesar Borgia, 1478-1507,
during the transactions which led up to the assassinations of the Orsini and Vitelli at
Cenegalia, and along with his letters to his chiefs in Florence, he has left an account,
written ten years before the prince, of the proceedings of the Duke in his Discretion
del Modo Tenuto del Duca Valentino, Nello Amazoni vitalazzo Vitelli, etc., a translation
of which is appended to the present work.
